The project references one of the packages being upgraded. This finding records the reference (current and proposed version) so the assessment lists every affected project even when no breaking API changes were detected.
Pkg.0001.label: Project references an upgraded package

PkgApi.0001.description:
Source code uses a type or member that was removed in the proposed NuGet package version.

The referenced API no longer exists in the target version of the package. The code needs to be updated to use a replacement API before upgrading the package.
PkgApi.0001.label: Usage of API removed in the new package version

PkgApi.0002.description:
Source code uses a member whose signature changed in the proposed NuGet package version.

The member still exists in the target version of the package but its signature is different (for example, parameters or return type changed). The call site needs to be updated to match the new signature before upgrading the package.
PkgApi.0002.label: Usage of API whose signature changed in the new package version
